name: takeover-mid-duel
description: G5/D1: nobody plays cart until 18.6 s, in the middle of the recorded duel: Lokier's recorded hit has landed on the puppet (18.50 s, 27 HP) and the puppet's spray has fired its first shot. The player takes control at the window and keeps playing the recording: his shots are real (D1), so his next would-hit bullet kills Lokier, a little before the tape's 18.80 s, and the round stays on script.
